title: Driving from Tirana to Theth: A Summer Road‑Trip Guide
excerpt: Explore the 170 km summer drive from Tirana to Theth National Park, learn about road conditions, vehicle needs and where to collect your rental car at TIA.
intro: Summer opens the Albanian Alps to curious travelers. A self‑drive from Tirana to Theth lets you soak up rugged scenery, hidden villages and fresh mountain air—all at your own pace. Here’s everything you need to plan a safe, enjoyable road trip.

sections.title: Driving from Tirana to Theth: Route Overview
sections.body: The full journey covers roughly 170 km and takes about 3.5‑4.5 hours of active driving. It’s split into two clear parts: a 1.5‑hour stretch on the SH1 highway from Tirana to Shkodër, followed by a 2‑2.5‑hour mountain drive on SH21 from Koplik up to Theth. The SH21 pass was fully asphalted in 2021, meaning the classic 4x4 requirement has eased. Still, the road is narrow and winding, so plan for daylight travel and occasional pauses to enjoy the views while driving from Tirana to Theth.

sections.title: SH1 Highway: The First 1.5 Hours
sections.body: Leaving Tirana, the SH1 is a modern, well‑maintained two‑lane road that runs north‑west toward Shkodër. Traffic is light outside rush‑hour, and signage is clear in both Albanian and English. You’ll pass the coastal plain, see the Skanderbeg Bridge, and get a glimpse of Lake Shkodër on the horizon. Fuel stations and cafés are plentiful, making it a comfortable stretch for any rental car. Arriving in Shkodër, you can stretch your legs, grab a coffee, and prepare for the mountain ascent ahead.

sections.title: SH21 Mountain Pass: What to Expect
sections.body: From Koplik, the SH21 climbs into the Accursed Mountains. Though fully paved, the road remains narrow with sharp bends and steep drop‑offs on either side. In summer, the surface is generally dry, but occasional potholes appear after heavy rain. Visibility can change quickly, especially in fog‑prone valleys, so keep headlights on and drive cautiously. The ascent offers spectacular panoramas of alpine meadows and traditional stone houses. Plan to stop at the small village of Selca for a snack and to stretch before the final 30‑km push to Theth.

sections.title: Vehicle Choice and Safety Tips
sections.body: A standard compact or midsize sedan is sufficient for the summer drive, but choose a vehicle with at least 150 mm ground clearance to handle occasional gravel patches. Bring a spare tire, basic tool kit and a first‑aid kit—rural stations are sparse. Avoid night driving on SH21; the lack of street lighting and steep cliffs make it risky after dark. Keep a full tank before leaving Shkodër, and use GPS together with a paper map, as mobile signal can drop in deep valleys.

sections.title: Where to Pick Up Your Car
sections.body: International travelers arriving at Tirana Rinas (TIA) can collect their rental directly at the terminal. AutoConnect Rental offers a range of well‑maintained cars, from economical hatchbacks to higher‑clearance models, all inspected for mountain travel. The desk is located near the arrivals hall, making it easy to start your adventure without delay. Remember to check the car’s tire pressure and fluid levels before heading north, and ask the staff for a quick briefing on the SH21 conditions for the day.

tip.title: Start Early, Arrive Before Dusk
tip.body: Begin your drive around 8 AM. This gives you plenty of daylight for the winding SH21 section, lets you avoid afternoon fog in the valleys, and ensures you reach Theth before nightfall when the road becomes hazardous.

faq.question: Is the road from Tirana to Theth fully paved?
faq.answer: Yes. The entire SH21 mountain pass was asphalted in 2021, so the route from Tirana to Theth is now fully paved, though it remains narrow and winding.

faq.question: Do you need a 4x4 to drive to Theth?
faq.answer: A 4x4 is no longer mandatory in summer; a standard passenger car with decent ground clearance can handle the paved SH21, but a higher‑clearance vehicle adds extra safety on occasional gravel sections.

faq.question: How long does it take to drive from Tirana Airport to Theth?
faq.answer: The trip covers about 170 km and typically takes 3.5 to 4.5 hours of driving, depending on traffic, stops, and road conditions.
